significance: A rekha-deula temple at Kamali Bazar in Sambalpur, Odisha, built in the early 16th century under the Chauhan ruler Balaram Dev. It enshrines Vishnu reclining on the serpent Ananta.
story: The image of Narayana is said to have come to Sambalpur as part of the queen's dowry, after which the king raised the temple to house it.
